title: How is Julius Caesar connected to Sonic?
description:
Rome's first emperors, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a Vatican audience and The Tonight Show connect Julius Caesar to Sonic the Hedgehog.

Julius Caesar → Nero → Saint Peter → Pope Francis → Jimmy Fallon → Ben Schwartz → Sonic the Hedgehog

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
